# ProteinGym auxiliary partition

This directory is generated by `python -m data.build_proteingym_partition`.
It contains assay-disjoint ProteinGym stability/expression mutation examples:

- `train.json`: all remaining selected rows, at least 1,000,000 rows.
- `test.json`: at least 300,000 assay-held-out rows.
- `manifest.json`: counts, assay groups, and SHA-256 hashes.

These are non-antibody mutation-fitness measurements. They are auxiliary data
for mutation-effect representation learning and stress testing, not antibody
aggregation labels. Never combine these rows with the FLAb aggregation cohort
when reporting antibody aggregation performance.
